source.description:
Capability: Read one immutable, owner-authorized dataset from Files with the user's column metadata: a dated table by its time index, or a table keyed by labels as a static relation.

Read one immutable, owner-authorized dataset published from Files. A dated table: custom_data(source_ref=..., window=SourceWindow(start=EarliestAvailable, end=LatestAvailable))(). The selected timestamp column is the native index; EarliestAvailable/LatestAvailable use the saved source coverage. This reader supports no predecessor selection; include_previous_observation remains false. A table keyed by labels (no dates): custom_data(source_ref=...)() with no window. It is a shared static relation of all its rows in saved order, like etf_holdings: not a time series. Name the key you join or display by explicitly, through relation(...) into sql_program or a table's key=. The exact value fields, descriptions, units and types are resolved from that saved source before compilation; field names retain the uploaded column names. Rows, duplicates and missing values are preserved without filling, resampling or implicit alignment. Original parsing and manual enrichment happen before publication, with no AI needed at compile or runtime.
